title: fix(plugin-kanban): read the cardTitle/titleField pair once, through one resolver
body:
Fixes #8308

`ObjectKanban` resolved the same authoring choice — which record field titles a card, spelled `cardTitle` with `titleField` as its legacy alias — in two places with **two different operators**: `schema.cardTitle || schema.titleField` in the card list's `effectiveData` memo, and `schema.cardTitle ?? schema.titleField` in the record-detail drawer's heading. Those differ on exactly the falsy-but-present values, and on a string key that value is `''`, so a board authored `{ cardTitle: '', titleField: 'name' }` titled its **cards** from `name` while its **drawer heading** fell through to the object-label floor. One authored document, two answers.

## What changed

The pair is now read **once**, through the new exported `resolveKanbanTitleField`, and both sites call it — the shape `resolveKanbanCardFields` already gives `cardFields` in the same file.

⛔ Deliberately **not** fixed by making the drawer say `||`. That repairs today's two sites and leaves the property that produced them — the pair is readable ad hoc, anywhere — fully intact, so a third read site invents a third precedence. The census below is the half that reddens on that third site, and a two-operator fix would not have produced it.

## The ruling this carries, and where it is now written down

**`''` means UNSET on either key; `cardTitle` wins when NON-EMPTY.** `cardTitle` names a record *field*, and `''` can name none, so an empty string has no meaningful reading here — it can only be the residue of an empty input. It therefore falls through exactly as an absent key does.

That extends the precedence `index.tsx` already publishes in prose ("`cardTitle` wins when both are authored") to the single case that prose never covered. Nothing in the tree said what `''` meant here, which is the condition that let the two operators drift apart; `resolveKanbanTitleField`'s docblock now says it.

**Falsification checked, none found.** The ruling was to be voided by any site in the tree that parses `''` as a meaningful field name. Swept: every `cardTitle` / `titleField` read in `packages/` and `apps/`. The collectors filter `typeof f === 'string' && f`; the two view adapters floor an empty `titleField` with `|| 'name'`. The nearest thing to a counterexample is `ObjectGallery.tsx`'s `titleField != null && item[titleField] != null` — a different component and a different key, and `item['']` is `undefined`, so it does not resolve `''` to a field either.

## Discriminating power — measured, both legs restored

Both legs mutate `ObjectKanban.tsx` on disk, prove the mutation landed (`grep -c` on the injected and deleted text plus a blob-hash comparison against `HEAD`), run, then restore with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` and prove the restore by blob hash **and** an empty `git diff HEAD`. No build is involved: the spec imports the component relatively (`../ObjectKanban`) and the census reads the file off disk, so nothing here resolves through `dist/`.

**Leg 1 — put both operators back** (`resolveKanbanTitleField(schema)` call count in the component: 2 → 0). `Tests 3 failed | 8 passed (11)`:

| row | mutated | at HEAD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SUBJECT `{ cardTitle: '', titleField: 'name' }` titles BOTH surfaces from `name` | ❌ drawer accessible name was `Contacts Detail` | ✅ |
| CONTROL `{ cardTitle: 'subject', titleField: 'name' }` → `subject` on both | ✅ | ✅ |
| CONTROL `{ titleField: 'name' }` → `name` on both | ✅ | ✅ |
| census: no property read outside the resolver | ❌ 4 offenders, by name and offset | ✅ |
| census: both read points call the resolver | ❌ `undefined` call sites, expected 2 | ✅ |

The two controls are green on **both** sides of the fix, which is what makes them controls.

**Leg 2 — add a third ad-hoc read** (`const ablationThirdReadSite = schema.cardTitle ?? schema.titleField;`). `Tests 1 failed | 10 passed (11)` — only the census reddened, naming the new read. That is the structural pin doing the job the fence asked for.

## Verification

Run from the repo root (`pnpm exec vitest run PATH`, never the package-filtered form the objectui#3378 guard silently redirects), serialised on the container's shared heavy-verify lock; each verdict below is the runner's own `VERDICT command-exit` line.

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=...@object-ui/plugin-kanban --concurrency=2` — 40/40 tasks, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban run type-check` — echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/` — **43 files, 271 tests, all passing**, re-run at final `241b39f1f`.
- Cross-package watchers that read this file off disk — `object-kanban-record-source-7780`, `object-kanban-group-by-limit-7322`, `kanban-calendar-filter-sort-8174`, `base-bind-declared`, `kanban-arm-batch70-7742`, `kanban-plugin-dialect-authoritative-7664`: 6 files, 95 tests, exit 0.
- Gates derived from the diff: `check:control-bytes`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:changeset-presence` — all exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban run lint` exit 0 (181 pre-existing warnings, 0 errors).
- `check:readme-exports` exits 1 **as NOT MEASURED, not as a finding**: its eight remaining rows are `@object-ui/cli` and `@object-ui/plugin-ai`, two packages outside this diff and outside the dependency closure built here, each printing "run `pnpm build` first". `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` IS among the 35 judged packages and is clean.
- Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full suite, the doc-type gates that need a whole-tree build) are declared to CI.

## Position and content axes

- **Position (stored line citations).** `scripts/check-doc-example-types.mjs`'s `UNGATED_EXAMPLES` holds no `plugin-kanban` entry; no `.mjs` or `.json` in the tree stores a `ObjectKanban.tsx:NNN` address. The line citations that exist are prose in comments, were already stale before this change (they name `:350` / `:1024` for reads that were at `:552` / `:1303`), and `census:cross-file-line-citations` is report-only by objectui#8875's own ruling — noted, not churned here.
- **Content (who reads this file, not just who calls it).** Six cross-package watchers read `packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` off disk; all six are run above. `packages/sdui-parser/`'s census is scoped to `plugin-dashboard` and does not see this file.

## 验收备注

- The census deliberately uses the tree's one comment masker (`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`) rather than a hand-rolled stripper, following `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts`'s precedent — this file's own prose quotes `(schema as any).titleField` verbatim, which a naive regex would either count as a read or blank the code around.
- `resolveKanbanTitleField` reaches `dist/ObjectKanban.d.ts` but **not** `dist/index.d.ts`, and the package's `exports` map routes only `.` and `./style.css` — so it is not consumer-reachable, exactly like `resolveKanbanCardFields`. No README row is owed.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed: `ObjectKanbanComponentProps`'s docblock still cites `:350` / `:1024` for the `titleField` read — the substantive claim (both union arms are load-bearing) is still true, only the addresses are stale, and they were stale before this change.

Clause-②: yes
